section_summary.extract_value: This section details the measures used in the current study, including the Self-Compassion Scale-Short Form, the Body Comparison Orientation subscale from the BEECOM, the 13-item Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), and the 5-item Appearance subscale from the Contingencies of Self-Worth Scale. A demographic form was also used to collect self-reported sex (verified as female), age, ethnicity, sexual orientation, height, and weight, with height and weight used to calculate BMI. The text consistently refers to 'the current study' in the singular.
